messages:
pagerduty: [PAGER] Sev2 — spike of 5xx errors for runtime-gateway (us-west-2). Alert: 5xx-rate > 5% for 3m. Incident link: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-1978123456

ops-bot: runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runtime-gateway-triage — follow order: check recent deploys, check upstreams, add temporary suppressors if noise.

alex c: grabbing console, oncall starting triage. pinging infra.

maria g: I see a 12x spike in 502s starting at 14:02 UTC, aligns w/ increased client retries. dashboards: https://dash/rg/runtime-errors?window=15m.

jin p: no deploys in last 2 hours from CICD. suspect upstream timeout flapping to edge cache.

samir r: getting customer reports about chat timeouts, looks real. customer-impact: a handful of sessions timing out (~0.6% of traffic), not full outage but UX regression.

alex c: can we mitigate to reduce user impact and noisy pages? two steps: 1) live mitigation to reduce 5xx propagation, 2) fix alert noise so we don't page on repeated known transient signatures.

maria g: agree. for live mitigation I can flip the upstream retry profile down for runtime-gateway (lower retry attempts) — will reduce duplicate downstream load. doing now.

ops-bot: action: lowered upstream retries from 3 -> 1 for runtime-gateway in us-west-2 (change-id: cfg-9832).

maria g: rollback of retry spike applied. watching metrics. 5xxs down to baseline within 90s.

alex c: good. now for alert tuning: current rule fires on any 5xx > 5% — too sensitive for transient upstream flaps. propose two changes: 1) add a regex signature to ignore 5xx caused by known transient backend msg "connection reset by peer" repeated pattern, 2) change evaluation to use median over 3 mins and require >5% for 5 consecutive 1m windows before paging.

jin p: +1. we should also create a separate non-pageable metric for the aggregated 5xx that we keep as a dashboarded signal.

samir r: can we craft the log query now? I'll draft and push as PR to alerting repo.

samir r: DRAFT query (loki):
```
{job="runtime-gateway", env="prod", region="us-west-2"} |= "HTTP/1.1" | json | status >= 500
| status_count = count_over_time(status[1m])
| error_rate = status_count / count_over_time(requests[1m])
| label_drop_if_matches(error_message, "connection reset by peer")
| __error_rate__
```
Note: we will use `label_drop_if_matches` to exclude logs that match the transient message from the pageable signal.

maria g: regex to match transient pattern:
```
/(?i)connection reset by peer|upstream prematurely closed connection|broken pipe/
```
We'll add that to the alert rule as an exclusion.

alex c: for immediate paging suppression, add a signature rule that converts alerts with that regex into "info" for 10m if rate drops after mitigation. We should avoid completely ignoring, just avoid paging.

jin p: I created PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/+/PR-4582 — updates rule runtime-gateway-5xx, adds exclusion regex, changes evaluation to 5m consecutive windows and creates a non-pageable alert channel #runtime-5xx-watch.

ops-bot: PR-4582 checks: linter OK, tests pending (mocked metrics).

maria g: running test harness locally, small tweak to query needed (count_over_time usage). pushing fix.

samir r: pushed fix, CI green.

alex c: merging PR now.

ops-bot: PR-4582 merged by alex c. Deploying alert config to staging -> prod.

jin p: config deployed to prod at 14:18 UTC. New rule active.

maria g: monitoring: no new pages in last 10m, error rate trending down, customer impact reduced.

alex c: thanks team. follow-ups: 
- create ticket to evaluate threshold long-term and add synthetic checks (owner: jin p)
- add dashboard panel showing raw vs pageable 5xx split (owner: maria g)
- write up quick postmortem w/ timeline (owner: alex c)

samir r: filing tickets now. link: https://pm.redwood/tickets/PM-6822

ops-bot: oncall handoff: alex c -> jin p at 14:30 UTC. next oncall will keep an eye for regressions.

jin p: acknowledged, taking over. will follow up during the next OKR review with metrics.

alex c: closing thread for active triage — tagging for post-incident audit. :checkmark:

pagerduty: Incident INC-1978123456 status: mitigated, pages suppressed by modified rule. Please follow up in PM-6822 for retrospective.
